conflicts.topic: Gestational Diabetes Lunch & Dinner Carbohydrate Thresholds
conflicts.explanation: DOC-GEST-001 enforces a STRICT CEILING of max 30g carbohydrates at lunch/dinner, whereas DOC-GEST-002 enforces a MINIMUM FLOOR of 45g-60g carbohydrates to prevent maternal starvation ketonuria and protect fetal brain development. Both documents are currently approved for patient distribution.
